source.text:
IONOS?

Just me ranting but: I had a domain with them that I ... had on a 3-year renewal + auto-renewal set up, and the system tried to charge the renewal at the end of the first year(why?) which failed for unrelated reason, then apparently perma-deleted my billing account after few automatic warnings but with the DNS running for 2 more years(why?), plus a week or two after full grace period after expiry with zero communication(why?), and btw they no longer accept chat or email(why?), and only option is to call, which goes to Philippines anyway(why?), which got hanged up(why?) likely by call screening AI for my weird likely Fable-triggering Gmail address read aloud, which caused the support person to call me back for the rest of the call that lasted an hour(umm), and I apparently have $17 outstanding invoice that I need to pay, which is such an old invoice that they only take payment through bank transfer(why?) which is not trivial or cheap for me, for what? A thing that never happened because it never went through 2 years ago?

Like, this could have been extremely cheap email and a Visa payment if they didn't permanently close the billing account tied to an active contract they were honoring.

They will never recover from financial losses on me for this since: 1) this is likely costing them more than I've paid cumulatively, 2) they are not going to make back from recovery fee total, 3) neither of me and them would want businesses with each other, 4) the support person said there's no one to escalate which means they are not L1 and they are not paid less than $0.005/hour, and 5) the support person promised to call me later but never did so I assume I they were fired and that costs them hiring and training, all considered likely totaling somewhere between $500 to $1k on their side, of which I'd be technically only obligated to pay for $17 that I consider debatable, which costs their time and money to even receive.

I guess it's on me and I'm sorry but are they ... is there something wrong with their billing department???
